## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Identify any ownership, authorization, schema or infrastructure changes.

## Release

Add one label: `release:major` (full or breaking release, X.0.0), `release:minor` (new feature, 0.X.0), or `release:patch` (fix, 0.0.X). No label means patch. The next production release uses the largest label since the previous release.

## Verification

List commands and results, including negative authorization/concurrency cases where applicable. State checks that have not run. Do not mark scanner or build success as proof of production readiness.

## Cost and rollout

Gross recurring cost: previous estimate → proposed estimate; delta and usage assumptions. Unknown costs are not zero; credits are tracked separately.

Describe migration, data preservation and rollback. Identify any required cloud/environment approval and the exact reviewed artifact or plan.
